posts.title: Developments in Application Prompts for Memory Systems
posts.description: Andy Matuschak distinguishes two types of prompts: recall prompts and application prompts . Recall prompts are normal front-back/question-answer flashcards; application prompts involve explicitly *applying* information. Here are some Claude generated examples to distinguish the two types of prompts: Law - Recall: Which courts can hear patent claims?
